title: The etale local ring at a geometric point as a colimit over etale algebras with a point
statement:
Let $Y$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], let $ ar x:\operatorname{Spec}\Omega	o Y$ be a geometric point [def-weil-geometric-point] lying over $y\in Y$, and let $\kappa( ar x)\subset\Omega$ be the separable algebraic closure [def-weil-pbc-relative-separable-closure] of the residue field $\kappa(y)$ [def-weil-residue-field] in $\Omega$ (with $\kappa(y)	o\Omega$ given by $ ar x$). Let $U=\operatorname{Spec}A\subset Y$ be an affine open containing $y$ and $\mathfrak p\subset A$ the prime ideal of $y$, so that $\kappa(\mathfrak p)=\kappa(y)$. Let $\mathcal N$ be the category of affine pointed etale neighbourhoods $(V=\operatorname{Spec}A_V, ar v)$ of $ ar x$ [def-weil-pbc-pointed-etale-neighbourhoods] (a morphism $(V', ar v')	o(V, ar v)$ is a $Y$-morphism $V'	o V$ carrying $ ar v'$ to $ ar v$), and let $\mathcal T$ be the category of triples $(B,\mathfrak q,\phi)$ where $A	o B$ is a ring map with $\operatorname{Spec}B	o\operatorname{Spec}A$ etale [def-weil-etale-morphism], $\mathfrak q\subset B$ is a prime lying over $\mathfrak p$, and $\phi:\kappa(\mathfrak q)	o\kappa( ar x)$ is a homomorphism of $\kappa(\mathfrak p)$-algebras; a morphism $(B,\mathfrak q,\phi)	o(B',\mathfrak q',\phi')$ is an $A$-algebra map $ eta:B	o B'$ with $ eta^{-1}(\mathfrak q')=\mathfrak q$ and $\phi'\circ\kappa( eta)=\phi$. Then:

1. $\mathcal N$ is cofiltered: it is nonempty, any two objects receive morphisms from a common object, and any two parallel morphisms $V'ightrightarrows V$ are equalized by a morphism $V''	o V'$.
2. The full subcategory $\mathcal N_U\subset\mathcal N$ of those $(V, ar v)$ for which $V	o Y$ factors through $U$ is initial: every object of $\mathcal N$ receives a morphism from an object of $\mathcal N_U$. Hence the colimit $\varinjlim_{(V, ar v)\in\mathcal N}A_V$ [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit] is canonically the colimit over $\mathcal N_U$.
3. For $(V=\operatorname{Spec}B, ar v)$ in $\mathcal N_U$ let $v\in V$ be the image of $ ar v$, $\mathfrak q_v\subset B$ its prime, and $\phi_v:\kappa(\mathfrak q_v)	o\Omega$ the field homomorphism corresponding to $ ar v$ [def-weil-geometric-point]. Then $\phi_v$ is a $\kappa(\mathfrak p)$-algebra map with image in $\kappa( ar x)$, and $(V, ar v)\mapsto(B,\mathfrak q_v,\phi_v)$ is an equivalence of $\mathcal N_U$ with the opposite of $\mathcal T$. Consequently $\varinjlim_{\mathcal N}A_V=\varinjlim_{(B,\mathfrak q,\phi)\in\mathcal T}B$ canonically, compatibly with the maps from each $A_V$, $(V, ar v)\in\mathcal N_U$.

source.place: Lemma Tag 03PQ (lemma-cofinal-etale) for (1); Remark Tag 04HT (remark-etale-neighbourhoods: $\kappa(u)/\kappa(s)$ is finite separable for an etale neighbourhood) and the proof of Lemma Tag 04HX (lemma-describe-etale-local-ring), first paragraph (cofinal system of affine neighbourhoods over $\operatorname{Spec}(A)$ and the translation into triples $(B,\mathfrak q,\phi)$), for (2) and (3)

proof.text: *Setting up the affine chart.* Write $\iota:U=\operatorname{Spec}A\to Y$ for the open immersion of the chosen affine open. Since $\bar x$ has image $y\in U$, it factors uniquely as $\bar x=\iota\circ\bar x_U$ with $\bar x_U:\operatorname{Spec}\Omega\to U$ (universal property of the open immersion $\iota$); by [def-weil-affine-spectrum] $\bar x_U=\operatorname{Spec}\chi$ for a unique ring map $\chi:A\to\Omega$. The image point of $\bar x_U$ is the prime $\ker\chi$, so $\ker\chi=\mathfrak p$, and $\chi$ factors as $A\to\kappa(\mathfrak p)\xrightarrow{\bar\chi}\Omega$; under the identification $\kappa(\mathfrak p)=\kappa(y)$ (the open immersion $\iota$ induces an isomorphism of local rings $A_{\mathfrak p}=\mathcal O_{U,y}\cong\mathcal O_{Y,y}$, [def-weil-open-immersion], [def-weil-residue-field]) $\bar\chi$ is the field map $\kappa(y)\to\Omega$ of $\bar x$ [def-weil-geometric-point]. Hence $\kappa(\bar x)$ is the separable algebraic closure of $\kappa(\mathfrak p)$ in $\Omega$ via $\bar\chi$ [def-weil-pbc-relative-separable-closure]. Throughout, a morphism $\operatorname{Spec}\Omega\to\operatorname{Spec}B$ is $\operatorname{Spec}\psi$ for a unique ring map $\psi:B\to\Omega$, its image point is the prime $\ker\psi$, and $\psi$ factors uniquely as $B\to\kappa(\ker\psi)\xrightarrow{\bar\psi}\Omega$ ($B/\ker\psi\to\Omega$ is an injective map of a domain into a field, which extends uniquely to its fraction field); composition with $\operatorname{Spec}\beta$ corresponds to $\psi\mapsto\psi\circ\beta$.

proof.text: *Shrinking.* Let $\mathcal N^{\mathrm{all}}$ be the category of all pointed etale neighbourhoods $(V,\bar v)$ of $\bar x$ [def-weil-pbc-pointed-etale-neighbourhoods] ($V\to Y$ etale, $\bar v$ over $\bar x$, morphisms the $Y$-morphisms respecting the points); $\mathcal N$ is its full subcategory of affine objects. For every $(V,\bar v)$ in $\mathcal N^{\mathrm{all}}$ with image point $v$ and every open $W\subset V$ containing $v$, [lem-weil-pbc-pointed-etale-neighbourhood-affine-shrink] gives an affine $(V_0=\operatorname{Spec}R,\bar v_0)$ in $\mathcal N$ and a morphism $j:(V_0,\bar v_0)\to(V,\bar v)$ with $j$ an open immersion and $j(V_0)\subset W$. With $W=V$: every object of $\mathcal N^{\mathrm{all}}$ receives a morphism from an object of $\mathcal N$.

source.place: proof of Lemma Tag 04HX: 'A cofinal system is given by those etale neighbourhoods (U,u) such that U is affine'

proof.text: *Part (1): $\mathcal N$ is cofiltered.* By [lem-weil-pbc-pointed-etale-neighbourhoods-cofiltered] (Stacks 03PQ: the fibre product $V_1\times_YV_2$ with the point $(\bar v_1,\bar v_2)$, and for $h_1,h_2:(V,\bar v)\rightrightarrows(V',\bar v')$ the etale neighbourhood $V''=V'\times_{\Delta,V'\times_YV',(h_1,h_2)}V$) the category $\mathcal N^{\mathrm{all}}$ is cofiltered. $\mathcal N$ is a full subcategory of $\mathcal N^{\mathrm{all}}$ and by the previous step every object of $\mathcal N^{\mathrm{all}}$ receives a morphism from an object of $\mathcal N$; so by [lem-weil-pbc-colimit-initial-full-subcategory] (1) $\mathcal N$ is cofiltered. Concretely: $\mathcal N$ is nonempty (shrink $(Y,\bar x)$); for two objects of $\mathcal N$ shrink $(V_1\times_YV_2,(\bar v_1,\bar v_2))$, which need not be affine when $Y$ is not separated, to an affine object and compose with the projections; for two parallel morphisms of $\mathcal N$ shrink the equalizing $(V'',\bar v'')$ of 03PQ (2) and compose; morphisms of $\mathcal N^{\mathrm{all}}$ between objects of $\mathcal N$ are morphisms of $\mathcal N$ (fullness).

source.place: Lemma Tag 03PQ (lemma-cofinal-etale) and its proof; categories.tex Lemma Tag 0BUC (lemma-cofinal-in-filtered), dual form

proof.text: *Part (2): $\mathcal N_U$ is initial, and the colimit restricts.* Let $(V,\bar v)$ be in $\mathcal N$ with structure map $f:V\to Y$ and image point $v$; then $f(v)=y\in U$, so $W=f^{-1}(U)$ is an open of $V$ containing $v$. The shrinking step gives $j:(V_0,\bar v_0)\to(V,\bar v)$ with $V_0$ affine and $j(V_0)\subset W$, so $f\circ j$ has image in $\iota(U)$ and factors through the open immersion $\iota$ [def-weil-open-immersion]: $(V_0,\bar v_0)$ lies in $\mathcal N_U$. So every object of $\mathcal N$ receives a morphism from an object of the full subcategory $\mathcal N_U$. As $\mathcal N$ is cofiltered (part (1)), [lem-weil-pbc-colimit-initial-full-subcategory] (1) says that $\mathcal N_U$ is cofiltered and initial in $\mathcal N$, and that for the diagram $(V,\bar v)\mapsto A_V=\Gamma(V,\mathcal O_V)$ on $\mathcal N^{\mathrm{op}}$ (with the pullback maps $\Gamma(h):A_V\to A_{V'}$) the canonical map $\varinjlim_{\mathcal N_U}A_V\to\varinjlim_{\mathcal N}A_V$ [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit] is an isomorphism, either colimit existing with the other (both exist: filtered colimits of commutative rings exist).

source.place: proof of Lemma Tag 04HX: 'A cofinal system is given by those etale neighbourhoods (U,u) such that U is affine and U → S factors through Spec(A)'; categories.tex Lemma Tag 04E7 (lemma-cofinal)

proof.text: Cancel i in the point equation and apply Etale.of_comp to the chart map. Its residue-field extension is separable by the formally unramified, locally finite type instance. The residue embedding of the composite point is the composite of residue maps. Regard the point embedding as an algebra homomorphism over the base residue field and apply IsSeparable.map. mem_separableClosure_iff then proves the image lies in K.
Apply the chart-to-triples equivalence theorem to the proved residue-image containment. It supplies E, δ, and the precise ring and point compatibility equations.

The initially-small property of pointSmallEtale supplies colimits on the opposite category of all pointed neighbourhoods. Initiality of the affine inclusion and chart inclusion transfers existence to D and DU. Transfer through δ and E to DT. Choose colimit cocones; r is the final-inclusion colimit isomorphism, and s is its inverse followed by the natural-diagram and equivalence colimit isomorphisms. Their coprojection equations follow from ι_colimitIso_hom, ι_colimitIso_inv, and isoOfNatIso_ι_hom.

split_report.summary: Statement kept (checked against Stacks 03PQ, 04HT and the first paragraph of the proof of 04HX; N is the affine neighbourhoods, as in the user lem-weil-pbc-strict-henselization-functoriality and def-weil-pbc-strict-henselization-limit). Proof written in 8 steps following 04HX: affine chart and ring-level description of Spec-Omega points; shrinking to affine opens; (1) cofilteredness of the affine neighbourhoods from cofilteredness of all pointed etale neighbourhoods (03PQ; Mathlib instance in Sites/EtalePoint.lean) plus a full weakly initial subcategory argument (the fibre product of two affine neighbourhoods need not be affine over a non-separated Y, which the statement's 'affine' requires); (2) N_U initial via the preimage of U, and restriction of the colimit; (3) the equivalence N_U = T^op (objects, using that residue extensions of etale algebras are separable algebraic so phi lands in kappa(x-bar); full faithfulness using that the open immersion U -> Y is a monomorphism; surjectivity on objects); colimit identification via invariance under equivalence and Gamma(Spec B)=B. Five new nodes, all Mathlib leaves: pointed-etale-neighbourhoods-cofiltered, pointed-etale-neighbourhood-affine-shrink, etale-algebra-residue-field-separable, etale-composition-cancellation, colimit-initial-full-subcategory. lem-weil-pbc-etale-base-change-finite-limits is not needed: the fibre products of 03PQ are inside the cofilteredness leaf.

lean.statement: theorem etale_local_ring_triples (Y : Scheme.{v}) (Ω : Type v) [Field Ω] [IsAlgClosed Ω] (A : CommRingCat.{v}) (i : Spec A ⟶ Y) [IsOpenImmersion i] (xU : Spec (.of Ω) ⟶ Spec A) : let x := xU ≫ i let p := (SpecToEquivOfField Ω (Spec A) xU).1 let F := (Spec A).residueField p let e := (SpecToEquivOfField Ω (Spec A) xU).2 letI : Algebra F Ω := e.hom.toAlgebra let K := separableClosure F Ω let χ : F ⟶ CommRingCat.of K := CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap F K) let Nall := (pointSmallEtale x).fiber.Elements let P : ObjectProperty Nall := fun c => IsAffine c.1.left let N := P.FullSubcategory let Q : ObjectProperty N := fun c => ∃ g : c.obj.1.left ⟶ Spec A, g ≫ i = c.obj.1.hom let NU := Q.FullSubcategory let D := (P.ι ⋙ CategoryOfElements.π (pointSmallEtale x).fiber ⋙ Etale.forget Y ⋙ Over.forget Y).op ⋙ Scheme.Γ let DU := Q.ι.op ⋙ D let T := EtaleResidueTriples A p K χ let DT := etaleResidueTriplesRingDiagram A p K χ IsCofiltered N ∧ Q.ι.Initial ∧ (∀ c : N, ∃ d : NU, Nonempty (d.obj ⟶ c)) ∧ (∀ (c : NU) (z : c.obj.obj.1.left.residueField (SpecToEquivOfField Ω c.obj.obj.1.left c.obj.obj.2.left).1), (SpecToEquivOfField Ω c.obj.obj.1.left c.obj.obj.2.left).2 z ∈ K) ∧ ∃ (E : NUᵒᵖ ≌ T) (δ : DU ≅ E.functor ⋙ DT), (∀ c : NU, let t := E.functor.obj (op c) (∀ g : c.obj.obj.1.left ⟶ Spec A, g ≫ i = c.obj.obj.1.hom → (ΓSpecIso A).inv ≫ g.appTop ≫ δ.hom.app (op c) = t.α) ∧ c.obj.obj.2.left ≫ c.obj.obj.1.left.toSpecΓ = Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom K.subtype) ≫ Spec.map ((ΓSpecIso t.B).inv ≫ (Spec t.B).Γevaluation t.q ≫ t.φ) ≫ Spec.map (δ.hom.app (op c))) ∧ ∃ (cn : Cocone D) (cu : Cocone DU) (ct : Cocone DT), Nonempty (IsColimit cn) ∧ Nonempty (IsColimit cu) ∧ Nonempty (IsColimit ct) ∧ ∃ (r : cu.pt ≅ cn.pt) (s : cn.pt ≅ ct.pt), (∀ c : NUᵒᵖ, cu.ι.app c ≫ r.hom = cn.ι.app (Q.ι.op.obj c)) ∧ (∀ c : NUᵒᵖ, cn.ι.app (Q.ι.op.obj c) ≫ s.hom = δ.hom.app c ≫ ct.ι.app (E.functor.obj c))
